12528.instructions: Pour vodka and coffee liqueur over ice cubes in an old-fashioned glass. Fill with light cream and serve.

12562.name: Alice Cocktail
12562.instructions: Shake well, strain into a large cocktail glass.

12564.name: Apple Karate
12564.instructions: Place all ingredients in the blender jar - cover and whiz on medium speed until well blended. Pour in one tall, 2 medium or 3 small glasses and drink up.

12572.name: Bora Bora
12572.instructions: Prepare in a blender or shaker, serve in a highball glass on the rocks. Garnish with 1 slice of pineapple and one cherry.

12618.name: Orangeade
12618.instructions: Place some ice cubes in a large tumbler or highball glass, add lemon juice, orange juice, sugar syrup, and stir well. Top up with cold soda water, serve with a drinking straw.

12630.name: Rail Splitter
12630.instructions: Mix sugar syrup with lemon juice in a tall glass. Fill up with ginger ale.

12654.name: Banana Milk Shake
12654.instructions: Blend very well, preferably in a household mixer. Serve in a wine glass, garnish with whipped cream and a piece of banana.

12656.name: Banana Strawberry Shake
12656.instructions: Blend all together in a blender until smooth.

12658.name: Banana Strawberry Shake Daiquiri
12658.instructions: Blend all together in a blender until smooth.

12668.name: Egg Cream
12668.instructions: Mix syrup and milk in a fountain glass. Add soda water, serve with a straw.

12670.name: Fruit Cooler
12670.instructions: Toss strawberries with sugar, and let sit overnight in refrigerator. Cut lemon, reserve two slices. Juice the rest. Mix together the lemon juice, strawberries, apple juice, and soda water. Add slices of lemon (decor, really). In glasses, put ice cubes, and a slice of apple. Pour drink in, and serve.

12672.name: Fruit Flip-Flop
12672.instructions: Place all ingredients in the blender jar - cover and whiz on medium speed until well blended. Pour in one tall, 2 medium or 3 small glasses and drink up.

12688.name: Just a Moonmint
12688.instructions: Place all ingredients in the blender jar - cover and whiz on medium speed until well blended. Pour in one tall, 2 medium or 3 small glasses and drink up.

12690.name: Lassi - A South Indian Drink
12690.instructions: Blend in a blender for 3 seconds. Lassi is one of the easiest things to make, and there are many ways of making it. Basically, it is buttermilk (yoghurt whisked with water), and you can choose almost any consistency that you like, from the thinnest to the thickest. Serve cold.

12692.name: Lassi Khara
12692.instructions: Blend (frappe) in blender until frothy. Add torn curry leaves and serve cold.

12694.name: Lassi Raita
12694.instructions: Blend the yoghurt and ice cubes together, until the yoghurt becomes more liquid. Add sugar to taste. The lemon/lime is optional but it gives it a slightly tart taste. Dash of salt. Raita is also good for the summer. Instead of having a traditional salad you can make raita instead.

12696.name: Lassi - Sweet
12696.instructions: Put all ingredients into a blender and blend until nice and frothy. Serve chilled.

12698.name: Lassi - Mango
12698.instructions: Put it all in a blender and pour over crushed ice. You can also use other fruits like strawberries and bananas.

12702.name: Lemouroudji
12702.instructions: Juice the lemons. Peel and grate the ginger. Place the grated ginger and a liberal dash of the cayenne pepper into a piece of cheesecloth, and tie it into a knot. Let soak in the water. After 15 minutes or so, add the sugar, and the lemon juice. Chill, and serve.

12704.name: Limeade
12704.instructions: In a large glass, put the lime juice and sugar, and stir well. Add cold seltzer water to fill. Put the lime peels in the glass. Drink. Repeat until limes or soda run out.

12706.name: Aperol Gin Fizz
12706.instructions: Shake with ice and strain into cocktail glass.

12708.name: Banana Cantaloupe Smoothie
12708.instructions: Juice cantaloupe, pour juice into blender, add banana, and liquify.

12710.name: Apple Berry Smoothie
12710.instructions: Throw everything into a blender and liquify.

12712.name: Grape lemon pineapple Smoothie
12712.instructions: Throw everything into a blender and liquify.

12714.name: Kiwi Papaya Smoothie
12714.instructions: Throw everything into a blender and liquify.

12716.name: Mango Orange Smoothie
12716.instructions: Throw everything into a blender and liquify.

12718.name: Pineapple Gingerale Smoothie
12718.instructions: Throw everything into a blender and liquify.

12720.name: Kill the cold Smoothie
12720.instructions: Juice ginger and lemon and add it to hot water. You may add cardomom.

12722.name: Strawberry Shivers
12722.instructions: Place all ingredients in the blender jar - cover and whiz on medium speed until well blended. Pour in one tall, 2 medium or 3 small glasses and drink up.

12724.name: Sweet Bananas
12724.instructions: Place all ingredients in the blender jar - cover and whiz on medium speed until well blended. Pour in one tall, 2 medium or 3 small glasses and drink up.

12726.name: Tomato Tang
12726.instructions: Place all ingredients in the blender jar - cover and whiz on medium speed until well blended. Pour in one tall, 2 medium or 3 small glasses and drink up.

12728.name: Yoghurt Cooler
12728.instructions: Place all ingredients in the blender jar - cover and whiz on medium speed until well blended. Pour in one tall, 2 medium or 3 small glasses and drink up. Note: Use lots of ice in this one - great on hot days! To add ice: Remove the center of the cover while the blender is on - drop 3 or 4 ice cubs and blend until they're completely crushed.

12730.name: Castillian Hot Chocolate
12730.instructions: Shift the cocoa and sugar together into a medium-sized saucepan. Dissolve the cornstarch in the water, and stir into the cocoa and sugar until it is a smooth paste. Begin heating the mixture, stirring it with a whisk, and gradually pour in the milk. Continue stirring with the whisk as you bring the liquid to a simmer. Allow the chocolate to simmer for about 10 minutes, stirring often, until it is thick, glossy and completely smooth. Serve steaming hot in coffee mug. Serves six.

12732.name: Chocolate Beverage
12732.instructions: Boil milk in the top of a deep double boiler five minutes. Remove from fire and add chocolate, mixed with the cinnamon, a little at a time, beating with molinillo or egg beater after each addition. When the chocolate is thoroughly blended, heat to the boiling point. Place over bottom of double boiler and add eggs, whipping constantly, until they are thoroughly blended and the mixture is frothing. Serve in coffee mug. Serves eight.

12734.name: Chocolate Drink
12734.instructions: Melt the bar in a small amount of boiling water. Add milk. Cook over low heat, whipping gently (with a whisk, i would assume) until heated well. Don't let it boil! Serve in coffee mug.

12736.name: Drinking Chocolate
12736.instructions: Heat the cream and milk with the cinnamon and vanilla bean very slowly for 15-20 minutes. (If you don't have any beans add 1-2 tsp of vanilla after heating). Remove the bean and cinnamon. Add the chocolate. Mix until fully melted. Serve topped with some very dense fresh whipped cream. Serves 1-2 depending upon how much of a glutton you are. For a richer chocolate, use 4 oz of milk, 4 oz of cream, 4 oz of chocolate. Serve in coffee mug.

12738.name: Hot Chocolate to Die for
12738.instructions: Melt the chocolate, butter and vanilla in a double boiler. When just smooth stir in the cream.

12744.name: Microwave Hot Cocoa
12744.instructions: Combine sugar, cocoa, salt and hot water in 1-quart micro-proof measuring cup (or coffee mug). Microwave at HIGH (100%) for 1 to 1 1/2 minutes or until boiling. Add milk, sitr and microwave an additonal 1 1/2 to 2 minutes or until hot. Stir in vanilla, blend well.

12746.name: Nuked Hot Chocolate
12746.instructions: Mix with a bit of milk (1 oz or so) in coffee mug. Nuke mug for about 30-50 seconds. Stir until the heated cocoa dissolves. Fill mug with milk. Nuke for 1-2 minutes, depending on wattage and preferences as to burnt mouth parts.

12748.name: Orange Scented Hot Chocolate
12748.instructions: Combine all ingredients in heavy medium saucepan. Stir over low heat until chocolate melts. Increase heat and bring just to a boil, stirring often. Remove from heat and whisk untily frothy. Return to heat and bring to boil again. Remove from heat, whisk until frothy. Repeat heating and whisking once again. Discard orange peel. (Can be prepared 2 hours ahead. Let stand at room temperature. Before serving, bring just to boil, remove from heat and whisk until frothy.) Pour hot chocolate into coffee mugs. Makes 2 servings.

12750.name: Spanish chocolate
12750.instructions: Stir the milk with the chocolate and the cinnamon over low heat until the chocolate dissolves. Add the eggs and beat the mixture until it becomes thick, taking care not to boil. Serve in coffee mug.

12752.name: Lemon Shot
12752.instructions: Mix Galliano and Absolut Citron in a shot glass, lay lemon wedge sprinkled with sugar over glass and pour a rum over wedge and glass. light rum with a lighter and let burn for a second. Do shot quickly and suck on lemon. If it is done correctly, this will taste like a shot of sweet lemonade.

12756.name: Autodafé
12756.instructions: Mix and fill up with soda water. Drunk by finns on a sunny day any time of the year and day.

12758.name: Gagliardo
12758.instructions: Shake well and serve in a cocktail glass. This is a home cocktail of American/Internet Bar del Pozzo, Pavia, Italy.

12764.name: Karsk
12764.instructions: Put a copper coin in a coffe-cup and fill up with coffee until you no longer see the coin, then add alcohol until you see the coin. Norwegian speciality.

12766.name: Happy Skipper
12766.instructions: Pour Captain Morgan's Spiced Rum over ice, fill glass to top with Ginger Ale. Garnish with lime. Tastes like a cream soda. Named for the Gilligan's Island reference ("The Captain" *in* "Ginger" is a Happy Skipper!)

12768.name: Frappé
12768.instructions: Mix together. Blend at highest blender speed for about 1 minute. Pour into a glass and drink with a straw. Notes: This works best if everything is cold (if you make fresh coffee, mix it with the milk and let it sit in the fridge for 1/2 hour. If it is not frothy, add more milk, or even just some more milk powder. The froth gradually turns to liquid at the bottom of the glass, so you will find that you can sit and drink this for about 1/2 hour, with more iced coffee continually appearing at the bottom. Very refreshing.

12770.name: Iced Coffee
12770.instructions: Mix together until coffee and sugar is dissolved. Add milk. Shake well. Using a blender or milk shake maker produces a very foamy drink. Serve in coffee mug.

12772.name: Iced Coffee Fillip
12772.instructions: Mix together in a coffee mug and chill before serving.

12774.name: Masala Chai
12774.instructions: Bring 2 cups of water to boil. Add all the ingredients and boil again for about 15 seconds. Let stand for a minute. Warm milk in a pot. Filter tea into cups. Add milk and sugar. That's IT.

12776.name: Melya
12776.instructions: Brew espresso. In a coffee mug, place 1 teaspoon of unsweetened powdered cocoa, then cover a teaspoon with honey and drizzle it into the cup. Stir while the coffee brews, this is the fun part. The cocoa seems to coat the honey without mixing, so you get a dusty, sticky mass that looks as though it will never mix. Then all at once, presto! It looks like dark chocolate sauce. Pour hot espresso over the honey, stirring to dissolve. Serve with cream.

12780.name: Spiking coffee
12780.instructions: Incidentally, a pinch of cinnamon is indeed a nice addition to coffee but true heaven is a cardamom seed. Of course, you serve it in a coffee mug.

12782.name: Thai Coffee
12782.instructions: Place the coffee and spices in the filter cone of your coffee maker. Brew coffee as usual, let it cool. In a tall glass, dissolve 1 or 2 teaspoons of sugar in an ounce of the coffee (it's easier to dissolve than if you put it right over ice). Add 5-6 ice cubes and pour coffee to within about 1 inch of the top of the glass. Rest a spoon on top of the coffee and slowly pour whipping cream into the spoon. This will make the cream float on top of the coffee rather than dispersing into it right away.

12784.name: Thai Iced Coffee
12784.instructions: Prepare a pot of coffee at a good European strength. In the ground coffee, add 2 or 3 freshly ground cardamom pods. Sweeten while hot, then cool quickly. Serve in highball glass over ice, with cream. To get the layered effect, place a spoon atop the coffee and pour the milk carefully into the spoon so that it floats on the top of the coffee.

12786.name: Thai Iced Tea
12786.instructions: Combine Thai tea (i.e., the powder), boiling water, and sweetened condensed milk, stir until blended. Pour into 2 tall glasses filled with ice cubes. Garnish with mint leaves. Makes 2 servings.

12790.name: Absinthe #2
12790.instructions: Mix together and let sit a few days. Strain through a coffee filter. To serve mix 1 part absinthe to 4 parts water, add ice, enjoy.

12792.name: Amaretto Liqueur
12792.instructions: Combine sugar and 3/4 cup water in a small saucepan. Bring to a boil, stirring constantly. Reduce heat and simmer until all sugar is dissolved. Remove from heat and cool. In an aging container, combine apricot halves, almond extract, grain alcohol with 1/2 cup water, and brandy. Stir in cooled sugar syrup mixture. Cap and let age for 2 days. Remove apricot halves. (Save apricot halves, can be used for cooking). Add food coloring and glycerine. Stir, recap and continue aging for 1 to 2 months. Re-bottle as desired. Liqueur is ready to serve but will continue to improve with additional aging.

12794.name: Angelica Liqueur
12794.instructions: Combine all herbs, nuts and spices with vodka in a 1 quart or larger aging container. Cap tightly and shake daily for 2 weeks. Strain through a fine muslin cloth or coffee filter, discarding solids. Clean out aging container. Place liquid back in container. Place sugar and water in saucepan and stir to combine over medium heat. When sugar is completely dissolved, set aside and let cool. When cool combine with food coloring and add to liqueur liquid. Cap and allow to age and mellow in a cool, dark place for one month.

12796.name: Caribbean Orange Liqueur
12796.instructions: Pare very thinly the bright-colored rind from the oranges (no white). Blot the peel on paper towels to remove any excess oil. Put peel in a 4 cup screw-top jar. Add 2 cups vodka. Close jar. Store in a cool, dark place for 2 days or until the vodka has absorbed the flavor. Remove peel and add remaining vodka. Close jar and add remaining cup of vodka. Close the jar and store in a cool dark place at least 1 month to age.

12798.name: Coffee Liqueur
12798.instructions: Combine coffee, sugar and water. Simmer 1 hour and let cool. Add vanilla and vodka. Age in sealed jar 2 to 3 weeks.

12800.name: Coffee-Vodka
12800.instructions: Boil water and sugar until dissolved. Turn off heat. Slowly add dry instant coffee and continue stirring. Add a chopped vanilla bean to the vodka, then combine the cooled sugar syrup and coffee solution with the vodka. Cover tightly and shake vigorously each day for 3 weeks. Strain and filter. Its also best to let the sugar mixture cool completely so the vodka won't evaporate when its added. If you like a smoother feel to the liqueur you can add about 1 teaspoon of glycerine to the finished product.

12802.name: Cranberry Cordial
12802.instructions: Place the chopped cranberries in a 2 liter jar that has a tight-fitting lid. Add the sugar and rum. Adjust the lid securely and place the jar in a cool, dark place. Invert the jar and shake it every day for six weeks. Strain the cordial into bottles and seal with corks.

12808.name: Creme de Menthe
12808.instructions: Bring sugar and water to a boil and simmer for 10 minutes. Cool. Add the remaining ingredients and stir. Cover and let ripen for 1 month.

12820.name: Irish Cream
12820.instructions: Mix scotch and milk. Add half-and-half. Add rest.

12854.name: Scottish Highland Liqueur
12854.instructions: Combine all ingreds in aging container. Cover tightly and shake gently several times during the first 24 hrs. After 24 hrs, remove the lemon zest. Cover again and let stand in a cool, dark place for 2 weeks, shaking gently every other day. Strain through a wire sieve to remove the angelica root and fennel. Return to aging container, cover and let stand undisturbed in a cool dark place for 6 months. Siphon or pour clear liqueur into a sterile bottle. The cloudy dregs may be saved for cooking.

12856.name: Tia-Maria
12856.instructions: Boil water, sugar and coffe for 10 mins and let cool. Add rum and vanilla. Put in clean bottle(s) and leave for 1 week before using.

12862.name: Aloha Fruit punch
12862.instructions: Add 1/4 cup water to ginger root. Boil 3 minutes. Strain. Add the liquid to the guava, lemon and pineapple juices. Make a syrup of sugar and remaining water. Cool. Combine with juices and pineapple. Chill throroughly.

12864.name: Apple Cider Punch
12864.instructions: If you use the whole all spice and cloves, tie them in cheesecloth. Heat the mixture. Stir occasionally. If you want an alcoholic drink, rum would be nice.

12870.name: Artillery Punch
12870.instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a large punch bowl with a block of ice. If found too dry, sugar syrup may be added. Decorate with twists of lemon peel.

12876.name: Berry Deadly
12876.instructions: Add all ingredients to large bowl. Stir gently. Serve chilled.

12890.name: Cranberry Punch
12890.instructions: Combine first four ingredients. Stir until sugar is dissolved, chill. Then add ginger ale just before serving. Add ice ring to keep punch cold.

12910.name: Egg Nog #4
12910.instructions: In a small mixer bowl beat egg yolks till blended. Gradually add 1/4 cup sugar, beating at high speed till thick and lemon colored. Stir in milk, stir in rum, bourbon, vanilla, and salt. Chill thoroughly. Whip cream. Wash beaters well. In a large mixer bowl beat egg whites till soft peaks form. Gradually add remaining 1/4 cup sugar, beating to stiff peaks. Fold yolk mixture and whipped cream into egg whites. Serve immediately. Sprinkle nutmeg over each serving. Serve in a punch bowl or another big bowl. NOTE: For a nonalcoholic eggnog, prepare Eggnog as above, except omit the bourbon and rum and increase the milk to 3 cups.

12914.name: Egg-Nog - Classic Cooked
12914.instructions: In large saucepan, beat together eggs, sugar and salt, if desired. Stir in 2 cups of the milk. Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until mixture is thick enough to coat a metal spoon and reaches 160 degrees F. Remove from heat. Stir in remaining 2 cups milk and vanilla. Cover and regfigerate until thoroughly chilled, several hours or overnight. Just before serving, pour into bowl or pitcher. Garnish or add stir-ins, if desired. Choose 1 or several of: Chocolate curls, cinnamon sticks, extracts of flavorings, flavored brandy or liqueur, fruit juice or nectar, ground nutmeg, maraschino cherries, orange slices, peppermint sticks or candy canes, plain brandy, run or whiskey, sherbet or ice-cream, whipping cream, whipped. Serve immediately.

12916.name: Egg Nog - Healthy
12916.instructions: Whip egg substitute and sugar together, combine with the two kinds of milk, vanilla, and rum. Mix well. Chill over night. Sprinkle with nutmeg. Makes 6 servings.

12944.name: Gluehwein
12944.instructions: Boil sugar and spices in water, leave in the water for 30 minutes. Strain the spiced water and mix with the wine. Heat slowly until short of boiling temperature. (To remove alcohol, let it boil for a while.) You may add lemon or orange juice to taste. Serve in irish coffee cup.

12954.name: Holloween Punch
12954.instructions: Take a bunch of grape juice and a bunch of fizzy stuff (club soda, ginger ale, lemonlime, whatever). Mix them in a punch bowl. Take orange sherbet and lime sherbet. Scoop out scoops and float them in the punch, let them melt a little so that a nasty film spreads all over the top of the punch but there are still "bubbles" in it in the form of sherbet scoops. Looks horrible, tastes just fine.

12988.name: Mulled Wine
12988.instructions: Simmer 3 cups water with, sugar, cloves, cinnamon sticks, and lemon peel in a stainless steel pot for 10 minutes. Add wine heat to a "coffee temperature" (DO NOT BOIL) then add the brandy.

13020.name: Sangria
13020.instructions: Mix all together in a pitcher and refrigerate. Add cloves and cinnamon sticks to taste. Serve in wine glasses.

13024.name: Sweet Sangria
13024.instructions: Dissolve the sugar in hot water and cool. Peel the citrus fruits and break into wedges. Mix the wine, sugar syrup, fruit, and Fresca in a pitcher and put in the fridge for a few hours. Serve in tall glasses with a straw.

13026.name: Sangria The  Best
13026.instructions: Mix wine, sugar and fruit, and let sit in the fridge for 18-24 hours. The mixture will have a somewhat syrupy consistency. Before serving stir in brandy and cut the mixture with soda water until it have a thinner, more wine like consistency. Serve from a pitcher in wine glasses.

13032.name: Spiced Peach Punch
13032.instructions: Combine peach nectar, orange juice and brown sugar in a large saucepan. Tie cinnamon and cloves in a small cheesecloth bag. Drop into saucepan. Heat slowly, stirring constantly, until sugar dissolves. Simmer 10 minutes. Stir in lime juice. Serve in hot mugs.

13036.name: Strawberry Lemonade
13036.instructions: Throw everything into a blender and mix until fairly smooth. Serve over ice.

13042.name: Sunny Holiday Punch
13042.instructions: Combine all ingredients in a punch bowl.

13056.name: Wine Cooler
13056.instructions: Mix wine and soft drink. Pour into glass. Add ice.

13058.name: Wine Punch
13058.instructions: Combine all of the ingredients and pour over a block of ice.

13066.name: Bruce's Puce
13066.instructions: In a regular-sized shot glass, layer, with a spoon or cherry, the grenadine , the Kahlua , then the Bailey's Irish cream in equal portions. It goes down really smooth ,and you don't even need a chaser. It tastes just like chocolate milk.(Really!)

13068.name: Brave Bull Shooter
13068.instructions: Pour Tabasco into bottom of shot glass and fill with tequila.

13070.name: Fahrenheit 5000
13070.instructions: Cover bottom of shot glass with Tabasco Sauce and then fill with half Firewater and half Absolut Peppar.

13072.name: Popped cherry
13072.instructions: Served over ice in a tall glass with a popped cherry (can add more popped cherries if in the mood)!

13086.name: Atomic Lokade
13086.instructions: In a shaker, place lemonade, vodka, blue Curacao, and triple sec together. Shake with ice and strain into glass. Add sugar to taste

13128.name: Diesel
13128.instructions: Pour the lager first then add the blackcurrant cordial. Top up with the cider. The colour sholud be very dark approaching the colour of Guiness.

13162.name: Afternoon
13162.instructions: Build into a suiting glass, with no ice. Cream on top if wanted. Served directly.

13190.name: Kool-Aid Shot
13190.instructions: Pour into a large glass with ice and stir. Add a little cranberry juice to taste.

13192.name: National Aquarium
13192.instructions: Pour all ingredients into a shaker of ice. Shake well. Serve on the rocks.

13194.name: Damned if you do
13194.instructions: Pour into shot glass. Put in mouth. Repeat as deemed necessary.

13196.name: Long vodka
13196.instructions: Shake a tall glass with ice cubes and Angostura, coating the inside of the glass. Por the vodka onto this, add 1 slice of lime and squeeze juice out of remainder, mix with tonic, stir and voila you have a Long Vodka

13198.name: Quick F**K
13198.instructions: In a shot glass add 1/3 Kahlua first. Then 1/3 Miduri, topping it off with a 1/3 bailey's irish cream

13200.name: Owen's Grandmother's Revenge
13200.instructions: Add ingredients and mix in blender.

13202.name: Flaming Dr. Pepper
13202.instructions: Add Amaretto, Bacardi, and vodka. Mix in the Dr. Pepper and beer

13204.name: New York Lemonade
13204.instructions: Serve in a chilled cocktail glass. Lemon and sugar the rim. Stir and Strain.

13206.name: Caipirissima
13206.instructions: Same as Caipirinha but instead of cachaca you add WHITE RUM. It's great!!!!!!!!

13214.name: Pisco Sour
13214.instructions: Vigorously shake and strain contents in a cocktail shaker with ice cubes, then pour into glass and garnish with bitters.

13222.name: Big Red
13222.instructions: Pour ingredients into 1 ounce shot glass

13282.name: Black & Tan
13282.instructions: Fill pint glass half full with Bass. Next pour Guiness over a spoon slowly until glass is full. If done correctly the Guiness will stay on top and the Bass on bottom hence the name Black & Tan.

13328.name: Chocolate Milk
13328.instructions: Put the milk in the bottom, pour the Liquer on top and add the dash of amaretto. Do not mix. SLAM IT!

13332.name: B-53
13332.instructions: Layer the Kahlua, Sambucca and Grand Marnier into a shot glas in that order. Better than B-52

13377.name: Sea breeze
13377.instructions: Build all ingredients in a highball glass filled with ice. Garnish with lime wedge.

13389.name: Snake Bite (UK)
13389.instructions: Pour ingredients into a pint glass. Drink. Fall over.

13395.name: Bob Marley
13395.instructions: Layer in a 2 oz shot glass or pony glass

13405.name: Brainteaser
13405.instructions: layered erin first, then sambuca and then avocart(should sit in middle of other two. To drink: use a straw to suck up avocart then shot the rest and then suck fumes up through straw.

13423.name: Atlantic Sun
13423.instructions: Shake all the ingredients, top the drink with soda. Garnish with a slice of orange.

13499.name: Oreo Mudslide
13499.instructions: Blend Vodka, Kahlua, Bailey's, ice-cream and the Oreo well in a blender. Pour into a large frosted glass. Garnish with whipped cream and a cherry.

13539.name: Ice Pick
13539.instructions: Put Vodka in glass fill with iced tea. Stir in lemon to taste.

13621.name: Tequila Sunrise
13621.instructions: Pour the tequila and orange juice into glass over ice. Add the grenadine, which will sink to the bottom. Stir gently to create the sunrise effect. Garnish and serve.

13683.name: Apple Slammer
13683.instructions: pour into a shot glass and present to consumer, they are expected to cover the top of the shotglass with thier palm, raise the glass, slam it on the bar and the swallow quickly.

13731.name: Amaretto Sour
13731.instructions: Shake and strain. Garnish with a cherry and an orange slice.

13751.name: Cuba Libra
13751.instructions: Fill tall glass with ice cubes. Add rum. Rub cut edge of lime on rim of glass then squeeze juice into glass. Fill with Coca-Cola. Garnish with lime slice. Enjoy!

13775.name: Jelly Bean
13775.instructions: mix equal parts in pony glass-tastes just like a jelly bean!

13807.name: After Five
13807.instructions: 1. Pour Kahlua into shot glass to about 1/2 full. 2. Using a spoon(inverted), slowly pour in the Peppermint Schnapps until glass is about 3/4 full. Done correctly, the Schnapps will flow under the Kahlua for a clear layer. 3. Again using a spoon, but this time right side up, slowly top off the glass with a layer of Bailey's. Be careful to place the spoon right at the top of the Kahlua layer and to raise it as the glass fills up. Done correctly, this will provide a layer of Bailey's floating over the Kahlua. 4. Toss it down all at once for something like a Peppermint Pattie, WITH A BANG!!! NOTE: Best if all ingredients are chilled

13837.name: Kir Royale
13837.instructions: Pour Creme de cassis in glass, gently pour champagne on top

13899.name: 3 Wise Men
13899.instructions: put them them in a glass... and slam it to tha head.

13936.name: Miami Vice
13936.instructions: First: Mix pina colada with 2.5 oz. of rum with ice(set aside). Second: Mix daiquiri with 2.5 oz. of rum with ice. Third: While frozen, add pina colda mix then daiquiri mix in glass (Making sure they do not get mixed together).

13938.name: AT&T
13938.instructions: Pour Vodka and Gin over ice, add Tonic and Stir

13940.name: 69 Special
13940.instructions: Pour 2 oz. gin. Add 4 oz. 7-up. Add Lemon Juice for flavor. If you are weak, top up glass with more 7-Up.

13971.name: Irish Coffee
13971.instructions: Heat the coffee, whiskey and sugar; do not boil. Pour into glass and top with cream; serve hot.

14029.name: 57 Chevy with a White License Plate
14029.instructions: 1. Fill a rocks glass with ice 2.add white creme de cacao and vodka 3.stir

14053.name: Mother's Milk
14053.instructions: Shake over ice, strain. Serves two.

14065.name: Zippy's Revenge
14065.instructions: Mix Kool-Aid to taste then add Rum and ammaretto. shake well to disolve the sugar in the Kool-Aid... serve cold

14071.name: Belgian Blue
14071.instructions: Just pour all ingredients in the glass and stir...

14087.name: Red Snapper
14087.instructions: One shot each, shake n shoot

14095.name: Jamaica Kiss
14095.instructions: Fill a tumbler with ice cubes. Add a shot of Tia Maria and a shot of Jamaican light rum. Fill the tumbler with milk. Blend until smooth and serve immediately.

14107.name: Absolut Summertime
14107.instructions: Add all ingredients except lemon to shaker filled with ice. Cover and shake vigorously. Strain contents into ice filled collins glass. Garnish with lemon.

14133.name: Cosmopolitan Martini
14133.instructions: Pour all ingredients in mixing glass half filled with ice, shake and strain into chilled Martini glass.

14157.name: Ziemes Martini Apfelsaft
14157.instructions: Serve without ice. At least the juice shold have room temperature.

14167.name: Vodka Martini
14167.instructions: Shake the vodka and vermouth together with a number of ice cubes, strain into a cocktail glass, add the olive and serve.

14181.name: Cafe Savoy
14181.instructions: Fill mug almost to top with coffee.Add milk, triple sec and brandy. Stir.

14195.name: Snowball
14195.instructions: Place one ice cube in the glass and add 1 1/2 oz of Advocaat. Fill up the glass with lemonade and decorate with a slice of lemon. Serve at once.

14209.name: Mocha-Berry
14209.instructions: pour 6 oz. of coffee in a mug or Irish coffee cup. add coca mix and chambord, mix well and top off with whipped cream.

14229.instructions: pour kaluha, then Baileys, then Frangelico not chilled and not layered -- SERVE!!!

14272.name: Addison Special
14272.instructions: Combine ingredients in the order listed into a shaker. Fill half full with ice and shake well. Strain into glass with ice and garnish with a cherry and orange wedge.

14282.name: California Root Beer
14282.instructions: Put Kahlua and Galliano in highball glass fill with soda

14356.name: Blind Russian
14356.instructions: Fill glass with ice. Add all liquers. Add milk. shake.

14360.name: Absolut Sex
14360.instructions: Shake Absolut Kurant, Midori, and Cranberry juice in shaker with ice: Strain into rocks glass: Splash of seven on top.Absolut Sex.

14364.name: Aztec Punch
14364.instructions: Mix all ingredients in a pitcher. Mix thoroughly and pour into whatever is available, the bigger the better! This drink packs a big punch, so don't over do it.

14366.name: Lemon Drop
14366.instructions: Shake and strain into a chilled cocktail glass rimmed with sugar.

14372.name: Absolut limousine
14372.instructions: Fill Absolut into a glass. Add Lime juice. Add Ice and lime wedges.

14374.name: Absolut Evergreen
14374.instructions: Mix, pour over ice and top up with Bitter Lemon.

14378.name: Lunch Box
14378.instructions: Fill a pint glass almost full with beer. Then fill the rest with orange juice (careful not to fill it to the top). Then take the shot of Amaretto and drop it in.

14446.name: Kool-Aid Slammer
14446.instructions: Fill half the shot glass with the kool-aid first. Then put a paper towel over the top of the glass and slowly pour in the vodka. If you do it right, you should be able to see that the two liquids are separated, with the vodka on top. Now slam it! The last thing you'll taste is the kool-aid.

14456.name: Kurant Tea
14456.instructions: Pour Absolut Kurant into a comfortably big tea-cup. Add the not too hot(!) apple tea and, if you like, some sugar. Enjoy!

14466.name: Dirty Nipple
14466.instructions: This is a layered shot - the Bailey's must be on top

14482.name: Darkwood Sling
14482.instructions: There are many good cherry liqueurs you can use, but I prefere Heering. Add one share of the liqueur. Then you add one share of Soda. For a sour sling use Tonic (most people prefer the drink without Tonic). Afterwards you fill the glass with Orange Juice and ice cubes.

14510.name: Bailey's Dream Shake
14510.instructions: Blend ingredients for 30 seconds. Definitely refreshing for a hot summer's day !

14538.name: Bumble Bee
14538.instructions: This is a layered shot. First pour the Bailey's into the shot glass. Then take an upside down spoon and touch it to the inside wall of the glass. Carefully add the Kahlua. Repeat this process for the Sambuca. If done properly, the alcohol will stay separated and resemble a bumble bee. Enjoy!!!

14564.name: A Splash of Nash
14564.instructions: Drop shot glass with banana & melon liquers into a 9 oz hi- ball glass containing soda water and cranberry juice. Drink in one shot.

14578.name: Amaretto Sunrise
14578.instructions: Mix together the amaretto and orange juice. Pour into glass and then add the grenadine untill you see the sunrise.

14584.name: Arizona Stingers
14584.instructions: Place ice cubes in the hurricane glass . Add the 2 HEAPING shots of Absolute Vodka (Note: You can add as many shots of Absolute as you want!) Fill the rest of glass with the Arizona Icetea with lemon. Stir to mix using a spoon. Drink up and enjoy!!!!!!!

14586.name: Orange Push-up
14586.instructions: Combine liquors in a blender. Add a half scoop of ice and blend. Garnish with an orange and cherry flag. So good it will melt in your mouth!!!

14588.name: 151 Florida Bushwacker
14588.instructions: Combine all ingredients. Blend until smooth. Garnish with chocolate shavings if desired.

14594.name: Zizi Coin-coin
14594.instructions: Pour 5cl of Cointreau on ice, add 2cl of fresh lemon (or lime) juice, stir gently, and finally add slices of lemon/lime in glass.

14598.instructions: fill glass with crushed ice. Add vodka. Add a splash of grand-marnier. Fill with o.j.

14602.name: Tequila Surprise
14602.instructions: Fill shot glass with Tequila. Add drops of Tobasco sauce.

14608.name: Cream Soda
14608.instructions: Pour 1oz of Spiced Rum into a highball glass with ice. Fill with Ginger Ale.

14610.name: ACID
14610.instructions: Poor in the 151 first followed by the 101 served with a Coke or Dr Pepper chaser.

14622.name: Arctic Fish
14622.instructions: Fill glass with ice and fish, add vodka, grape soda and orange juice. DO NOT STIR!!!!! Serve well chilled.

14642.name: Grim Reaper
14642.instructions: Mix Kahlua and 151 in glass. Quickly add ice and pour grenadine over ice to give ice red tint.

14688.name: Freddy Kruger
14688.instructions: make it an ample size shot!!

14730.name: Bubble Gum
14730.instructions: Layer in order into a shot glass.

14752.name: Kiwi Lemon
14752.instructions: Mix in highball glass. Stirr. Garnish with slice of kiwi.

14842.name: Midnight Mint
14842.instructions: If available, rim cocktail (Martini) glass with sugar syrup then dip into chocolate flakes or powder. Add ingredients into shaker with ice. Shake well then strain into cocktail glass.

14860.name: Talos Coffee
14860.instructions: Add your GM and then add your coffee.

14888.name: Zinger
14888.instructions: Get a shot glass and pour in three shots of the schnapps. Do the same with the Surge Cola. Then down it like Scheetz would.

14956.name: Jello shots
14956.instructions: Boil 3 cups of water then add jello. Mix jello and water until jello is completely disolved. Add the two cups of vodka and mix together. Pour mixture into plastic shot glasses and chill until firm. Then, eat away...

14978.name: Rum Punch
14978.instructions: Mix all ingredients in a punch bowl and serve.

15006.name: Turkeyball
15006.instructions: Shake with ice and strain into a shot glass.

15024.name: Absolutely Cranberry Smash
15024.instructions: Stir ingredients together. Serve over ice.

15082.name: Royal Flush
15082.instructions: Pour all the ingredients into tumbler over ice. Strain into glass.

15086.name: Limona Corona
15086.instructions: Open the Corona. Fill the empty space in the neck in the bottle with the rum. The bottle should be filled to the top. Plug the bottle with your thumb or the palm of your hand. Turn the bottle upside-down so the rum and beer mix. Turn the bottle rightside-up, unplug, and drink.

15178.name: Texas Rattlesnake
15178.instructions: Mix all ingredients and Shake well. Sweet at first, with a BITE at the end...

15182.name: After sex
15182.instructions: Pour the vodka and creme over some ice cubes in a tall glass and fill up with juice. to make it beuty full make the top of the glass with a grenadine and sugar

15184.name: San Francisco
15184.instructions: Take a tall glass and put in a few ice cubes, fill the vodka over it and fill with juice then the "creme", to end fill in the grenadine but very carefully at the side of the glass so it will lay down in the bottom. garnish with orange and strawberry.

15194.name: Amaretto Shake
15194.instructions: Combine all ingredients in a blender and blend at high speed until smooth. Serve in chilled glass garnished with bittersweet chocolate shavings.

15200.name: A Day at the Beach
15200.instructions: Shake Rum, Amaretto, and Orange Juice in a shaker filled with ice. Strain over ice into a highball glass. Add Grenadine and garnish with a Pineapple Wedge and a Strawberry.

15224.name: Malibu Twister
15224.instructions: Add rum & trister then, add cranberry jucie,stir

15226.name: Space Odyssey
15226.instructions: Fill glass with ice and add shots of Bacardi and Malibu. Add splash of pineapple juice and top with orange juice. Add grenadine for color and garnish with cherries.

15266.name: Avalon
15266.instructions: Fill a tall glass with ice. Layer the Finlandia Vodka, lemon and apple juices, Pisang Ambon, and top up with lemonade. Stir slightly and garnish with a spiralled cucumber skin and a red cherry. The cucumber provides zest and looks attractive. This drink, created by Timo Haimi, took first prize in the 1991 Finlandia Vodka Long Drink Competition.

15288.instructions: Add both ingredients to shot glass, shoot, and get drunk quick

15300.name: 3-Mile Long Island Iced Tea
15300.instructions: Fill 14oz glass with ice and alcohol. Fill 2/3 glass with cola and remainder with sweet & sour. Top with dash of bitters and lemon wedge.

15328.name: Zorro
15328.instructions: add all and pour black coffee and add whipped cream on top.

15330.name: Orange Crush
15330.instructions: Add all ingredients to tumbler-Pour as shot

15346.name: 155 Belmont
15346.instructions: Blend with ice. Serve in a wine glass. Garnish with carrot.

15403.name: Vodka Russian
15403.instructions: Mix it as a ordinary drink .

15409.name: Danbooka
15409.instructions: pour it in and mix it.

15423.name: 110 in the shade
15423.instructions: Drop shooter in glass. Fill with beer

15427.name: Grand Blue
15427.instructions: Serve in an old fashioned glass.

15511.name: Baby Eskimo
15511.instructions: Leave ice-cream out for about 10 minutes. Add ingredients in order, stir with chopstick (butter knife or spoon works too). Consume immediately and often. Nice and light, great for following a heavy drink.

15515.name: Tennesee Mud
15515.instructions: Mix Coffee, Jack Daniels and Amaretto. Add Cream on top.

15521.name: Swedish Coffee
15521.instructions: Pour the coffee in an ordinary coffee cup. Add the aquavit. Add sugar by taste. Stir and have a nice evening (morning)

15567.name: Adam Sunrise
15567.instructions: Fill blender up with ice. Fill half with Bartons Vodka. Put 10 tsp of sugar, add 1/2 can lemonade concentrate, fill to top with water. Blend for 60 seconds.

15597.name: Absolut Stress #2
15597.instructions: Mix well. Garnish with Orange and Cherry. Enjoy

15615.name: Chocolate Monkey
15615.instructions: blend liqeuors with ice-cream, milk and syrup. pour into parfait glass, top with whipped cream and garnish with banana and cherry.

15639.name: Texas Sling
15639.instructions: Blend with Ice until smooth. Serve in a tulip glass, top with whip cream.

15675.name: A midsummernight dream
15675.instructions: Mix the strawberrys in a blender Pour it together with the vodka,kirch and strawberry liquer over ice in a shaker. Shake well and pour in a highballglass. Fill up with the Russchian water

15691.name: Zoksel
15691.instructions: No specific mixing instructions, just poor every ingredient in one glass. The lemon goes with it.

15743.name: Fuzzy Asshole
15743.instructions: fill coffe mug half full of coffee. Fill the other half full of Peach Schnapps. Stir and drink while hot.

15761.name: Quick-sand
15761.instructions: Simply add the orange juice, quite a quick pour in order to mix the sambucca with the orange juice. The juice MUST have fruit pulp!

15789.name: Snakebite and Black
15789.instructions: Put blackcurrant squash in first up to about 1cm in glass. Then add the lager and cider one after another.

15801.name: Zimadori Zinger
15801.instructions: Pour Zima in a collins glass over ice and then pour the shot of Midori. Don't stir. Garnish with a cherry.

15813.name: Herbal flame
15813.instructions: Pour Hot Damn 100 in bottom of a jar or regular glass. Fill the rest of the glass with sweet tea. Stir with spoon, straw, or better yet a cinnamon stick and leave it in.

15825.name: Jamaican Coffee
15825.instructions: Stir the rum, coffee and water together. Top with the whipped cream. Sprinkle with a pinch of well ground coffee and drink with a straw.

15841.name: Mojito Extra
15841.instructions: Put mint with lemon juice in a glas, mash the mint with a spoon, ice, rum & fill up with club soda. Top it with Angostura.

15849.name: Apricot punch
15849.instructions: Pour all ingrediants into a large punch bowl. Add ice and 4 oranges that are peeled and divided.

15853.name: B-52
15853.instructions: Layer ingredients into a shot glass. Serve with a stirrer.

15933.name: Zambeer
15933.instructions: Mix sambuca with rootbeer and stir. Add ice

15941.name: Americano
15941.instructions: Pour the Campari and vermouth over ice into glass, add a splash of soda water and garnish with half orange slice.

15951.name: Black Forest Shake
15951.instructions: In a blender put ice cubes, chocolate syrup, cherry brandy, vodka, and milk. Blend very well.

15997.name: GG
15997.instructions: Pour the Galliano liqueur over ice. Fill the remainder of the glass with ginger ale and thats all there is to it. You now have a your very own GG.

16031.name: Radler
16031.instructions: Pour beer into large mug, slowly add the 7-up (or Sprite).

16041.name: Mudslinger
16041.instructions: Add all contents to a large jug or punch bowl. Stir well!

16047.name: Campari Beer
16047.instructions: Use a 15 oz glass. Add Campari first. Fill with beer.

16082.name: Almond Chocolate Coffee
16082.instructions: Pour in order into coffee cup. Top with whipped creme and chocolate shcvings.

16100.name: Amaretto Stone Sour Alternative
16100.instructions: Shake sour mix, tequila and amaretto with ice. Strain into highball glass. Add a splash of OJ. Garnish with orange slice and a cherry.

16108.name: 9 1/2 Weeks
16108.instructions: Combine all ingredients in glass mixer. Chill and strain into Cocktail glass. Garnish with sliced strawberry.

16134.name: Absolutly Screwed Up
16134.instructions: Shake it up it tasts better that way, but you can stir it if you want. 6 of those and you will be wasted for the rest of the night.

16158.name: Whitecap Margarita
16158.instructions: Place all ingredients in a blender and blend until smooth. This makes one drink.

16176.name: Bellini Martini
16176.instructions:
Add ice cubes to shaker.
Add vodka.
Add peach schnapps.
Add peach nectar.
Shake.
Strain into glass.
Add lemon twist peel.

16178.name: Jitterbug
16178.instructions: Wet glass, dip rim in sugar. Then add Ice. Then add everything else. It's that simple!

16196.name: Moranguito
16196.instructions: first you put rhe absinthe, then put tequila, then put the Granadine syrup.

16202.name: Amaretto Sweet & Sour
16202.instructions: Fill the blender with 3/4 ice. Add sweet & sour mix to the top of the ice. Add about 1" of pineapple juice, 1/2" of melon liqeur, and 1/2 to 1/4" of amaretto. Then blend the mix until it is of margaritta consistency or thinner.

16250.name: Rum Runner
16250.instructions: Mix all ingredients in glass & add ice.

16262.name: H.D.
16262.instructions: Mix the whisky and Baileys Cream in a beer-glass (at least 50 cl). Fill the rest of the glass with coffee.

16273.name: Shark Attack
16273.instructions: Mix lemonade and water according to instructions on back of can. If the instructions say to add 4 1/3 cans of water do so. Mix into pitcher. Add 1 1/2 cup of Vodka (Absolut). Mix well. Pour into glass of crushed ice. Excellent!

16275.name: Jack's Vanilla Coke
16275.instructions: After pouring in your ingredients, and adding 3-5 ice cubes, according to taste. Stir the drink with a stirrer to get the Vanilla off the bottom.

16289.name: Apple Grande
16289.instructions: Chill both ingredients!! Mix in a tumbler and enjoy!

16295.name: Bleeding Surgeon
16295.instructions: Pour Shot of Rum over slice of orange. Fill the remaining space in glass half way full of surge or similar drink. Finish off glass with cranberry juice. Be carefull, warm surge may foam over the glass.

16311.name: Applejack
16311.instructions: Add all ingredients into mixing glass, chill and strain into cocktail glass

16333.name: Adam Bomb
16333.instructions: Add ice to blender (or to glass if prefer on the rocks) then fruit, and fruite juice depending on personal prefference then add the Rum, Vodka, Tequila, and triple sec. blend till smooth, rim glass with sugar or salt and pour mixture in. garnish with lemon or lime slice.

16354.name: Arizona Antifreeze
16354.instructions: Pour all ingredients into shot glass and slam !!!!

16403.name: Black and Brown
16403.instructions: CAREFULLY to avoid explosive head formation: Pour Beer glass half full of favorite rootbeer and top off with Guinness.

16405.name: A Piece of Ass
16405.instructions: Put ice in glass. Pour in shots. Fill with Sour Mix.

16419.name: Avalanche
16419.instructions: Mix in highball glass over ice, shake well.

16447.name: Brandon and Will's Coke Float
16447.instructions: Scoop two large scoops of vanilla ice-cream into frosted beer mug. Next, add 2 ounces Maker's Mark. Then, pour in coke. Gently stir and enjoy.

16485.name: Flaming Lamborghini
16485.instructions: Pour the Sambuca and Kahlua into the Cocktail Glass and give the drinker a straw. Pour the Baileys and Blue Curacao into two sepsrate shot glasses either side of the cocktail glass. Set light the concotion in the cocktail glass and start to drink through the straw (this drink should be drunk in one) , as the bottom of the glass is reached put out the fire by pouring the Baileys and Blue Curacao into the cocktail glass and keep drinking till it's all gone!!

16942.name: Zipperhead
16942.instructions: Fill glass with rocks, add straw before putting in liquor. Then add the ingredients in order, trying to keep layered as much as possible (i.e. Chambord on bottom, then Vodka, Then soda on top).

16951.name: Kioki Coffee
16951.instructions: Stir. Add whipped cream to the top.

16958.name: Apple Pie with A Crust
16958.instructions: Just mix the two liquids and sprinkle in the cinnamon. Serve either cold or heated.

16963.name: Zorbatini
16963.instructions: Prepare like a Martini. Garnish with a green olive.

16967.name: Vodka Fizz
16967.instructions: Blend all ingredients, save nutmeg. Pour into large white wine glass and sprinkle nutmeg on top.

16984.name: Radioactive Long Island Iced Tea
16984.instructions: Pour all ingredients over ice in a very tall glass. Sip cautiously.

16985.name: Shot-gun
16985.instructions: Pour one part Jack Daneils and one part Jim Beam into shot glass then float Wild Turkey on top.

16986.name: Bible Belt
16986.instructions: Mix all ingredients, and pour over ice.

16987.name: Irish Curdling Cow
16987.instructions: Pour Irish Cream, Vodka, and Bourbon in a glass. Add some ice and mix in the orange juice.

16990.name: Sweet Tooth
16990.instructions: Put 2 shots Godiva Liquour into a glass, add as much or as little milk as you would like.

16991.name: Downshift
16991.instructions: Start with the Sprite. Next comes the tequila. After that, add the Minute Maid Fruit Punch, then float the 151. Rocks optional.

16992.name: Pink Penocha
16992.instructions: mix all ingredients into bowl keep iced stir frequently

16995.name: Orange Whip
16995.instructions: Pour ingredients over ice and stir.

16998.name: Bruised Heart
16998.instructions: Pour all ingredients in a mixing tin over ice, stir, and strain into shot glass

17005.name: A True Amaretto Sour
17005.instructions: Rub the rim of an old fashioned glass with lemon, and dip repeatedly into granulated sugar until it has a good "frosted" rim. Shake a jigger of Amaretto with the juice of 1/2 a lemon. Strain into glass and add ice. Garnish with a Marachino Cherry.

17006.name: Kool First Aid
17006.instructions: Add Kool Aid to a double shot glass, and top with rum. Slam and shoot.

17015.name: Irish Russian
17015.instructions: Add the ingredients in the order listed in the recipe. Care must be taken when adding the Guinness to prevent an excess of foam. Do Not add ice.

17020.name: Auburn Headbanger
17020.instructions: Mix in spread glass over ice. Strain and pour in shot glass. Sit down before shotting. ENJOY!!

17027.name: Zima Blaster
17027.instructions: Fill glass with ice. Pour in Chambord, then fill with Zima. Mix and enjoy.

17035.name: Buccaneer
17035.instructions: Pour the corona into an 18oz beer glass pour the bacardi limon into the beer stir very gently

17044.name: Homemade Kahlua
17044.instructions: Dissolve sugar in 2 cups of boiling water and add corn syrup. Dissolve the instant coffee in the remaining water. Pour syrup and coffee in a gallon jug. Let it cool. Add vodka and vanilla when cold. For the best result, let the mixture "mature" for 4-5 weeks.

17065.name: Caribbean Boilermaker
17065.instructions: Pour the Corona into an 18oz beer glass pour the rum into the beer.

17066.name: Army special
17066.instructions: Pour Vodka, Gin and lime cordial into glass, and top up with crushed ice. Wait for ice to melt slightly and sip without a straw.

17074.name: Arizona Twister
17074.instructions: Just mix in the shots of rum, vodka, and tequila. Add splashes of the three juices, heavy on the pineapple. Top off with grenadine. Crushed ice should already be in glass. Top off the glass with a pineapple wedge.

17079.name: Baby Guinness
17079.instructions: Pour Kahlua, almost filling shot glass. Then, carefully pour Baileys, using wall of shot glass. This will give the "Guinness" its "head".

17094.name: Alice in Wonderland
17094.instructions: Just mix the three ingredients one to one to one

17105.name: 501 Blue
17105.instructions: Mix equal amounts into a glass with ice.

17108.name: Coke and Drops
17108.instructions: Take a glass, pour the Coke in the glass, then you take 7 drops of lemon juice. Granish with a lemon slice on the rim of the glass.

17114.name: Ruby Tuesday
17114.instructions: Pour gin and cranberry into a highball filled with ice cubes. Add grenadine and stir.

17118.name: Arctic Mouthwash
17118.instructions: Blend all ingredients in a blender on high until ice is finely crushed. It should be of a slushy consistency. Pour immediately and serve.

17120.name: Brain Fart
17120.instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Slowly and gently. Works best if ice is added to punch bowl and soda's are very cold.

17122.name: Royal Bitch
17122.instructions: Into a shot glass layer the Crown Royal on top of the Frangelico.

17135.name: Citrus Coke
17135.instructions: Pour half of coke in a glass. Then add Bacardi and top it off with the remaining coke. Stir and drink up!

17141.name: Smut
17141.instructions: Throw it all together and serve real cold.

17167.name: Raspberry Cooler
17167.instructions: Pour the raspberry vodka and soda into a highball glass almost filled with ice cubes. Stir well.

17168.name: Amaretto Sunset
17168.instructions: Shake ingredients in bartender's mixer quickly, just 5 shakes. Strain out ice, serve in glass immediately with a slice of orange.

17174.name: Cherry Electric Lemonade
17174.instructions: Now stir vigorously and then pour over a large cup of ice. Now drink it with a straw and stir occasionally.

17176.name: Ipamena
17176.instructions: Cut half a lime into pieces, place in a shaker, add the sugar and crush. Measure the passion fruit juice, add it to the shaker and fill up with ice cubes. Close the shaker and shake vigorously. Pour the liquid into a glass, top up with ginger ale, stir with a teaspoon and then garnish the rim of the glass with a slice of lime

17177.name: Dark Caipirinha
17177.instructions:
Muddle the sugar into the lime wedges in an old-fashioned glass.
Fill the glass with ice cubes.
Pour the cachaca into the glass.
Stir well.

17178.name: Jam Donut
17178.instructions: Coat the rim of a shot glass with sugar using sugar syrup to stick. Add the Chambord raspberry liqueur to the shot glass, and carefully layer the Baileys Irish Cream on top. Serve.

17180.name: Aviation
17180.instructions: Add all ingredients into cocktail shaker filled with ice. Shake well and strain into cocktail glass. Garnish with a cherry.

17181.name: Dirty Martini
17181.instructions:
Pour the vodka, dry vermouth and olive brine into a cocktail shaker with a handful of ice and shake well.
Rub the rim of a martini glass with the wedge of lemon.
Strain the contents of the cocktail shaker into the glass and add the olive.
A dirty Martini contains a splash of olive brine or olive juice and is typically garnished with an olive.

17182.name: Duchamp's Punch
17182.instructions:
Shake all ingredients.
Double strain in a chilled double old fashioned glass with abig ice cube.
Garnish with a couple of lavender sprigs

17183.name: Bacardi Cocktail
17183.instructions: Shake together with ice. Strain into glass and serve.

17184.name: Between The Sheets
17184.instructions: Pour all ingredients into shaker with ice cubes, shake, strain into chilled cocktail glass.

17185.name: Casino
17185.instructions: Pour all ingredients into shaker with ice cubes. Shake well. Strain into chilled cocktail glass. Garnish with a lemon twist and a maraschino cherry. Serve without a straw.

17186.name: Clover Club
17186.instructions: Dry shake ingredients to emulsify, add ice, shake and served straight up.

17187.name: Derby
17187.instructions: Pour all ingredients into a mixing glass with ice. Stir. Strain into a cocktail glass. Garnish with a sprig of fresh mint in the drink.

17188.name: Mary Pickford
17188.instructions: Shake and strain into a chilled large cocktail glass

17189.name: Monkey Gland
17189.instructions: Shake well over ice cubes in a shaker, strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

17190.name: Paradise
17190.instructions: Shake together over ice. Strain into cocktail glass and serve chilled.

17191.name: Planter's Punch
17191.instructions: Pour all ingredients, except the bitters, into shaker filled with ice. Shake well. Pour into large glass, filled with ice. Add Angostura bitters, "on top". Garnish with cocktail cherry and pineapple.

17192.name: Porto flip
17192.instructions: Shake ingredients together in a mixer with ice. Strain into glass, garnish and serve.

17193.name: Stinger
17193.instructions: Pour in a mixing glass with ice, stir and strain into a cocktail glass. May also be served on rocks in a rocks glass.

17194.name: White Lady
17194.instructions: Add all ingredients into cocktail shaker filled with ice. Shake well and strain into large cocktail glass.

17195.name: Bellini
17195.instructions: Pour peach purée into chilled flute, add sparkling wine. Stir gently.

17196.name: Cosmopolitan
17196.instructions: Shake all ingredients hard with ice and double strain into a chilled coupe. Express orange peel over the surface if available.

17197.name: French 75
17197.instructions: Combine gin, sugar, and lemon juice in a cocktail shaker filled with ice. Shake vigorously and strain into a chilled champagne glass. Top up with Champagne. Stir gently.

17198.name: French Connection
17198.instructions: Pour all ingredients directly into old fashioned glass filled with ice cubes. Stir gently.

17200.name: Grasshopper
17200.instructions: Pour ingredients into a cocktail shaker with ice. Shake briskly and then strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

17201.name: Hemingway Special
17201.instructions: Pour all ingredients into a shaker with ice. Shake.

17202.name: Horse's Neck
17202.instructions: Pour brandy and ginger ale directly into highball glass with ice cubes. Stir gently. Garnish with lemon zest. If desired, add dashes of Angostura Bitter.

17203.name: Kir
17203.instructions: Add the crème de cassis to the bottom of the glass, then top up with wine.

17204.name: Long Island Iced Tea
17204.instructions: Add all ingredients except cola to an ice-filled highball and stir. Top with a short pour of cola. This is a high-strength serve: one is plenty.

17205.name: Mimosa
17205.instructions: Ensure both ingredients are well chilled, then mix into the glass. Serve cold.

17206.name: Mint Julep
17206.instructions: In a highball glass gently muddle the mint, sugar and water. Fill the glass with cracked ice, add Bourbon and stir well until the glass is well frosted. Garnish with a mint sprig.

17207.name: Pina Colada
17207.instructions: Blend with crushed ice until smooth, or shake very hard and pour over crushed ice. Garnish with pineapple if available.
17207.existingVideoTitle: Make the Classic Pina Colada at home!🍍 #pinacolada #cocktails #recipe

17208.name: Rose
17208.instructions: Shake together in a cocktail shaker, then strain into chilled glass. Garnish and serve.

17209.name: Barracuda
17209.instructions: Shake pour ingredients with ice. Strain into glass, top with Sparkling wine.

17210.name: Bramble
17210.instructions: Fill glass with crushed ice. Build gin, lemon juice and simple syrup over. Stir, and then pour blackberry liqueur over in a circular fashion to create marbling effect. Garnish with two blackberries and lemon slice.

17211.name: Dark and Stormy
17211.instructions: In a highball glass filled with ice add 6cl dark rum and top with ginger beer. Garnish with lime wedge.

17212.name: Espresso Martini
17212.instructions: Shake vodka, fresh espresso and coffee liqueur very hard with ice. Double strain into a chilled coupe; add syrup only if needed.

17213.name: French Martini
17213.instructions: Pour all ingredients into shaker with ice cubes. Shake well and strain into a chilled cocktail glass. Squeeze oil from lemon peel onto the drink.

17214.name: Russian Spring Punch
17214.instructions: Pour the ingredients into an highball glass, top with Sparkling wine.

17215.name: Spritz
17215.instructions: Build into glass over ice, garnish and serve.

17217.name: Vampiro
17217.instructions: Vampiros may be made in a tall glass or an old fashioned glass. Bartenders may first "rim" the glass with Kosher Salt, which is done by placing a layer of Kosher Salt on a chopping board, moistening the glass' rim with lime juice or water, and then placing the upside down glass rim onto the Kosher Salt, so that the salt sticks to the moistened rim. The second step is to fill half the glass with ice and add one or two shooter glasses full of high quality Tequila. The next stage is to add the flavouring elements. This is done by squeezing a fresh lime into the glass, adding a few grains of salt, adding citrus-flavoured soda pop, until the glass is 4/5 full, and then adding spicy Viuda de Sanchez (or orange juice, lime juice and pico de gallo). The final step is to stir the ingredients so that the flavours are properly blended.

17218.name: Vesper
17218.instructions: Shake over ice until well chilled, then strain into a deep goblet and garnish with a thin slice of lemon peel.

17219.name: Yellow Bird
17219.instructions: Shake and strain into a chilled cocktail glass

17220.name: Butter Baby
17220.instructions: Blend together in a blender. Serve in a chilled Beer mug with Fresh Blueberries and caramel for topping.

17221.name: Boozy Snickers Milkshake
17221.instructions: Place the snickers bars in a plastic bag and roll over them with a rolling pin until crushed. Add crushed snickers pieces, ice cream, milk, caramel sauce, chocolate sauce, and chocolate liquor to a blender. Blend until shake is thick and frothy. Pour into glasses and top with chocolate liquor and whip cream.

17222.name: A1
17222.instructions: Pour all ingredients into a cocktail shaker, mix and serve over ice into a chilled glass.

17223.name: Abbey Martini
17223.instructions: Put all ingredients into a shaker and mix, then strain contents into a chilled cocktail glass.

17224.name: Absolutely Fabulous
17224.instructions: Mix the Vodka and Cranberry juice together in a shaker and strain into a glass. Top up with Champagne.

17225.name: Ace
17225.instructions: Shake all the ingredients in a cocktail shaker and ice then strain in a cold glass.

17226.name: Adam & Eve
17226.instructions: Shake together all the ingredients and strain into a cold glass.

17227.name: Addington
17227.instructions: Mix both the vermouth's in a shaker and strain into a cold glass. Top up with a squirt of Soda Water.

17228.name: Addison
17228.instructions: Shake together all the ingredients and strain into a cold glass.

17229.name: Adios Amigos Cocktail
17229.instructions: Shake together all the ingredients and strain into a cold glass.

17230.name: Gin Rickey
17230.instructions: Half-fill a tall glass with ice. Mix the gin and Grenadine together and pour over the ice. Add the lime or lemon juice and top off with soda water. Decorate the glass with lime and/or lemon slices.

17239.name: Hunter's Moon
17239.instructions: Put the Bombay Sapphire, Martini Bianco, sugar syrup & blackberries in a cocktail shaker with lots of ice and shake vigorously before pouring into a balloon glass, topping up with lemonade and garnishing with a wedge of orange.

17241.name: Zombie
17241.instructions:
Blend at high speed for no more than 5 seconds.

Pour into a glass, add ice cubes to fill, then add the garnish.

*Donn’s mix: Bring 3 crushed cinnamon sticks, 1 cup of sugar and 1 cup of water to a boil, stirring until the sugar is dissolved.

Simmer for 2 minutes, then remove from the heat and let sit for at least 2 hours before straining into a clean glass bottle.

Then add 1 part of the syrup and 2 parts of fresh grapefruit juice together.

17242.name: Bombay Cassis
17242.instructions:
Add the Bombay Sapphire, Crème de Cassis and lime juice to a balloon glass and swirl well to mix.
Fill the glass with good quality cubed ice.
Top up with chilled and freshly opened Fever-Tree Ginger Beer.
Gently stir to combine, top with a gently squeezed lime wedge and finish with a fresh ginger slice.

17245.name: Rosemary Blue
17245.instructions:
1) Add the Bombay Sapphire, Blue Curacao, rosemary sprig and gently squeezed lemon wedge to a balloon glass. Swirl well to combine.
2) Fill with cubed ice and top with the Fever-Tree Light Tonic Water.
3) Gently fold with a bar spoon to mix.

17246.name: Empellón Cocina's Fat-Washed Mezcal
17246.instructions:
To ensure that your pork fat is just as delicious as theirs, here’s their adobo marinade and what to do with it (you’ll also need a rack of ribs):

4 ancho chiles, 8 guajillo chiles and 4 chipotle chiles, plus 4 cloves roasted garlic, half a cup of cider vinegar, a quarter teaspoon of Mexican oregano, 1 teaspoon of ground black pepper, a whole clove, a quarter teaspoon of ground cinnamon and a half teaspoon of ground cumin.

Toast the dried chiles and soak in water for at least an hour until they are rehydrated. Drain and discard the soaking liquid. Combine the soaked chiles with the remaining ingredients and purée until smooth.

Cold smoke a rack of baby back pork ribs by taking a large hotel pan with woodchips on one side and charcoal on the other. Place another, smaller, pan with pork ribs, above the charcoal/woodchip pan. Ignite the charcoal, being careful to not ignite the woodchips. Cover both pans with foil and allow to smoke for 10-15 minutes, until desired level of smoke is achieved, then coat with adobo marinade and wrap in tin foil prior to placing ribs in a 300 degree oven for 7 hours. When the ribs have cooled, strain off the fat and use for the infusion.

If you’re having a hard time coming up to the same kind of volume of fat, make up the balance with pork lard from a butcher. To get the same depth of flavor without the ribs, heat up the fat in a pot with a few spoons of the marinade.

Once you’ve got your tub of seasoned pork fat in cooled liquid form, pour equal amounts of Ilegal Joven mezcal and fat into a sealable container. Seal the container and give it a really good shake, then put it in the freezer overnight. When the whole thing is separated and congealed, pour it through a fine mesh chinoise. If you don’t have a chinoise, try a fine mesh strainer, or if you don’t have one of those, try spooning off most of the fat. There will be some beads of orange fat left in the strained mezcal: run that through a few layers of cheesecloth (or coffee filters in a pinch) to get rid of the last of it.

The mezcal is now ready for drinking, straight-up or in a cocktail. 

Habanero tincture

Slice habaneros and add 2 ounces Ilegal Joven mezcal.
Allow to sit overnight or until desired level of heat is achieved.
Cocktail

Combine mezcal and chocolate liqueur in a mixing glass with ice and stir for 45 seconds.
Strain into chilled coupe.
Carefully "sink" the coffee liqueur down the inside of the coupe over a spoon.
Garnish with 5 drops habanero tincture.

17247.name: The Last Word
17247.instructions: Shake with ice and strain into a cocktail glass.

17248.name: French Negroni
17248.instructions:
Add ice to a shaker and pour in all ingredients.
Using a bar spoon, stir 40 to 45 revolutions or until thoroughly chilled.
Strain into a martini glass or over ice into a rocks glass. Garnish with orange twist.

17250.name: Corpse Reviver
17250.instructions: Shake, strain, straight up, cocktail glass rinsed with absinthe

17251.name: Boulevardier
17251.instructions: Stir with ice, strain, garnish and serve.

17252.name: Greyhound
17252.instructions:
Add the vodka to a Collins glass filled with ice.
Top with grapefruit juice and stir.

17253.name: Paloma
17253.instructions: Stir together and serve over ice.

17254.name: Bijou
17254.instructions: Stir in mixing glass with ice and strain

17255.name: Gimlet
17255.instructions:
Add all the ingredients to a shaker and fill with ice.

Shake, and strain into a chilled cocktail glass or an Old Fashioned glass filled with fresh ice.

Garnish with a lime wheel.

17256.name: Martinez 2
17256.instructions:
Add all ingredients to a mixing glass and fill with ice.

Stir until chilled, and strain into a chilled coupe glass.

17266.name: Oatmeal Cookie
17266.instructions:
Just mix it all together.
It's meant to be a shot, but it works just fine as a proper adult-sized drink over lots of ice.

Tastes like an oatmeal cookie.

17267.name: Bahama Mama
17267.instructions:
Add 2 parts club soda or more or less to taste.

Mix it all together and pour over a bunch of ice. Drink with a straw.

17268.name: Blue Hurricane
17268.instructions:
If each part is 1/2 oz then use about 2.5 cups of ice.

Blend it all together. 
Drink it with a big straw if you have one.

17824.name: The Laverstoke
17824.instructions:
1) Squeeze two lime wedges into a balloon glass then add the cordial, Bombay Sapphire and MARTINI Rosso Vermouth, swirl to mix.

2) Fully fill the glass with cubed ice and stir to chill.

3) Top with Fever-Tree Ginger Ale and gently stir again to combine.

4) Garnish with a snapped ginger slice and an awoken mint sprig.

17825.name: Brigadier
17825.instructions: Mix ingredients in a warmed mug and stir.

17826.name: The Jimmy Conway
17826.instructions:
Fill glass with ice
Pour in The Irishman and Disaronno
Fill to the top with Cranberry Juice
Garnish with a slice of lemon…Enjoy!

17827.name: Old Pal
17827.instructions: Chill cocktail glass. Add ingredients to a mixing glass, and fill 2/3 full with ice. Stir about 20 seconds. Empty cocktail glass and strain into the glass. Garnish with a twist of lemon peel.

17828.name: Tipperary
17828.instructions: Stir over ice. Strain into chilled glass. Cut a wide swath of orange peel, and express the orange oils over the drink. Discard orange twist.

17829.name: Penicillin
17829.instructions: Shake blended Scotch, lemon juice, honey syrup and ginger syrup with ice. Strain over large ice in chilled rocks glass. Float smoky Scotch on top (be sure to use a smoky Scotch such as an Islay single malt). Garnish with candied ginger.

17830.name: Corn n Oil
17830.instructions: Cut the half lime in half again. Add the lime, falernum, and bitters to a rocks glass. Muddle. Add the rum. (Aged Barbados rum such as Plantation 5 Year is recommended). Add ice and stir. Float the blackstrap rum on top. Serve with a straw.

17831.name: A Furlong Too Late
17831.instructions: Pour the rum and ginger beer into a highball glass almost filled with ice cubes. Stir well. Garnish with the lemon twist.

17832.name: A Night In Old Mandalay
17832.instructions: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine the light rum, añejo rum, orange juice, and lemon juice. Shake well. Strain into a highball glass almost filled with ice cubes. Top with the ginger ale. Garnish with the lemon twist.

17833.name: A. J.
17833.instructions: Shake ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

17834.name: Abbey Cocktail
17834.instructions: Shake all ingredients (except for the cherry) with ice and strain into a cocktail glass. Top with the cherry and serve.

17835.name: Abilene
17835.instructions: Pour all of the ingredients into a highball glass almost filled with ice cubes. Stir well.

17836.name: Acapulco
17836.instructions: Combine and shake all ingredients (except mint) with ice and strain into an old-fashioned glass over ice cubes. Add the sprig of mint and serve.

17837.name: Adam
17837.instructions: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine all of the ingredients. Shake well. Strain into a cocktail glass.

17838.name: Adonis Cocktail
17838.instructions: Stir all ingredients with ice, strain contents into a cocktail glass, and serve.

17839.name: Affair
17839.instructions: Pour schnapps, orange juice, and cranberry juice over ice in a highball glass. Top with club soda and serve.

17840.name: Affinity
17840.instructions: In a mixing glass half-filled with ice cubes, combine all of the ingredients. Stir well. Strain into a cocktail glass.

178306.name: Slippery Nipple
178306.instructions: Pour the Sambuca into a shot glass, then pour the Irish Cream on top so that the two liquids do not mix.

178307.name: Tequila Slammer
178307.instructions: Mix carefully to avoid releasing the dissolved CO2.

178309.name: Espresso Rumtini
178309.instructions: Mix together in a cocktail glass. Garnish with some choclate powder and coffee beans

178310.name: Brooklyn
178310.instructions: Combine ingredients with ice and stir until well-chilled. Strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

178311.name: Broadside
178311.instructions: Half fill the glass with ice cubes. Crush the wormwood and add to ice. Pour rum, scotch and butters, then serve!

178312.name: Bloody Punch
178312.instructions:
Place the thawed strawberries in a large bowl. Mash them with a fork to ensure no large chunks.

In a punch bowl or pitcher, combine mashed strawberries, lime pulp and soda. Mix well.

Add blueberries and raisins. They will float and look like bugs in the punch.

178313.name: Halloween Punch
178313.instructions:
Tip the cherry juice, orange peel, chilli, cinnamon sticks, cloves and ginger into a large saucepan. Simmer for 5 mins, then turn off the heat. Leave to cool, then chill for at least 4 hrs, or up to 2 days – the longer you leave it the more intense the flavours. If serving to young children, take the chilli out after a few hours.

When you’re ready to serve, pour the juice into a jug. Serve in glass bottles or glasses and pop a straw in each. If you're adding vodka, do so at this stage. Dangle a fangs sweet from each glass.

178314.name: Gin Basil Smash
178314.instructions: Muddle basil gently with syrup, add gin, lemon and ice, and shake hard. Double strain over fresh ice.

178315.name: Munich Mule
178315.instructions:
Fill glass with ice
Pour Gin and Lime Juice
Fill glass with Ginger Beer
Garnish with Cucumer and Lime slice

178317.name: Bee's Knees
178317.instructions:
Shake ingredients with crushed ice
Garnish with orange peel

178318.name: 747 Drink
178318.instructions:
Fill a Collins glass with ice.
Pour in vodka, lime cordial, and cranberry juice.
Fill up with Sprite.
Garnish with a Lime wheel or some cranberries

178319.name: Aquamarine
178319.instructions:
Shake well in a shaker with ice.
Strain in a martini glass.

178321.name: Amaretto fizz
178321.instructions: Mix Amaretto, orange juice and sparkling wine in a jug. Add a strip orange zest to each glass, if you like.

178322.name: Spice 75
178322.instructions:
Gently warm 60g golden caster sugar in a pan with 30ml water and 1 tbsp allspice. Cook gently until the sugar has dissolved, then leave the mixture to cool. Strain through a sieve lined with a coffee filter (or a double layer of kitchen paper).

Pour 60ml of the spiced syrup into a cocktail shaker along with 200ml rum and 90ml lime juice. Shake with ice and strain between six flute glasses. Top up with 600ml champagne and garnish each with an orange twist.

178323.name: Passion Fruit Martini
178323.instructions: Pour all ingredients into a glass and stir. Garnish with half a passion fruit piece.

178325.name: Aperol Spritz
178325.instructions: Put a couple of cubes of ice into 2 glasses and add a 50 ml measure of Aperol to each. Divide the prosecco between the glasses and then top up with soda, if you like.

178326.name: White Wine Sangria
178326.instructions: Chop the Lemon, Lime and other fruits into large chunks. Fill the Pitcher with the white wine and mix in the Apple Brandy. Top to taste with soda water.

178327.name: Pineapple Paloma
178327.instructions:
Rub the rim of each glass with lime slice and dip into salt.
Add ice, tequila, grapefruit juice, lime juice and top with pineapple soda.
Give it a quick stir.
Garnish with fresh pineapple or lime.

178328.name: Funk and Soul
178328.instructions: Mix all ingredients together and strain into a Collins glass. Use Jamaican rum where possible for a more authentic taste.

178329.name: Captain Kidd's Punch
178329.instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a shaker and strain into a collins glass. Use Caribbean dark Rum for a sweeter taste.

178330.name: The Philosopher
178330.instructions: Add all the spirits in a shaker (best to use Hendricks gin) as well as the orange bitters and lemon juice. Strain into a Margarita glass, top with Prosecco.

178331.name: Bounty Hunter
178331.instructions: Add the spirits into a shaker as well as the pineapple juice, strain into a Margarita glass. Top with Prosecco and garnish with Blueberries.

178333.name: Raspberry Julep
178333.instructions: Softly muddle the mint leaves and raspberry syrup in the bottom of the cup. Add crushed ice and Bourbon to the cup and then stir. Top with more ice, garnish with a mint sprig.

178334.name: Death in the Afternoon
178334.instructions: Easy as you like, pour the absinthe into a chilled glass, top with champagne. Must be drunk mid afternoon for the optimum effect.

178335.name: Lazy Coconut Paloma
178335.instructions: Mix the coconut liqueur (preferably tequila) with the grapefruit juice and top with soda water. Garnish with a large grapefruit slice against the inside of the glass.

178336.name: Blueberry Mojito
178336.instructions: Muddle the blueberries with the other ingredients and serve in a highball glass. Garnish with mint and a half slice of lime.

178337.name: Autumn Garibaldi
178337.instructions: Pour all ingredients into a glass over ice and stir with a bar spoon. Garnish with some orange slices.

178338.name: Pure Passion
178338.instructions: Mix up all ingredients with a cocktail stirrer and serve with crushed ice with mint and edible flour if available.

178340.name: Garibaldi Negroni
178340.instructions: Mix together in a shaker and garnish with a simple orange slice. Fill your vitamin C and cocktail fix at the same time!

178341.name: Orange Rosemary Collins
178341.instructions: Add the spirits to the bottom of the glass and top equally with the mixer drinks. Garnish with orange slices inside the glass as well as some rosemary on top.

178342.name: Gin and Soda
178342.instructions:
Pour the Gin and Soda water into a highball glass almost filled with ice cubes.
Stir well.
Garnish with the lime wedge.

178343.name: Michelada
178343.instructions:
Mix the beer with tomato juice, freshly squeezed lime juice, and Worcestershire sauce, teriyaki sauce, soy sauce, or hot sauce.
Served In a chilled, salt-rimmed glass

178344.name: Figgy Thyme
178344.instructions: In a lewis bag, crush up some ice like a baller/maniac (@glacioice). Pour your precious ice into a collins glass. In a cocktail shaker, muddle the figs and thyme together. Add honey vodka, lemon juice, and a large ice cube (@glacioice). Shake until well chilled, and strain into glass. Add tonic water and finally 2 dashes of angostura bitters. Garnish with sliced figs and thyme.

178345.name: Hot Toddy
178345.instructions:
STEP 1
Whisk the whisky and honey together and split between 2 heatproof glasses. Add half of the cinnamon stick to each, then top up with 200ml boiling water.

STEP 2
Add a splash of lemon juice to each, then taste and add more to your preference. Finish each with a slice of lemon, studded with a clove, and serve immediately.

178346.name: Elderflower Caipirinha
178346.instructions: Take the glass and muddle the lime in it. Fill the glass with crushed ice and add the Cachaca. Stir well and top with some more crushed ice. Garnish with lime and enjoy!

178347.name: Winter Rita
178347.instructions: Salt rim. Combine all ingredients, shake with ice, and strain over fresh ice.⠀

178348.name: Winter Paloma
178348.instructions: Everyone’s favourite Paloma gets a delicious Indian makeover. Tequila reposado infused with “Timur Pepper” which has citrusy & grapefruit notes and is grown at the foothills of Himalaya. It also produces a slightly numbing and tingling sensation on your lip when consumed. We have also spiced up the fresh grapefruit juice with the warming spice blend from Himalaya. The combination of all these interesting elements has allowed us to elevate your Paloma sipping experience.

178349.name: Snowday
